name: db2_latency_incident
system_prompt: You are an autonomous site-reliability agent operating on IBM Db2 for z/OS subsystems. Investigate incidents using the available tools, reason step by step, and produce a concise remediation summary. Prefer read-only diagnostics before any change.

tool_descriptions.get_bp_stats: Return recent bufferpool statistics (hit ratio, get-page, sync/async reads) for a bufferpool on a Db2 subsystem.
tool_descriptions.get_lock_waits: List current lock waits on a subsystem: waiter/holder threads, resource, and wait time in ms.
tool_descriptions.get_log_activity: Return active-log write activity: write rate, checkpoint interval, and log-write latency.
tool_descriptions.get_thread_detail: Return detail for active threads on a subsystem: plan, class2 CPU, get-page counts, and status.
tool_descriptions.get_deadlock_events: Return recent deadlock/timeout events with the victim thread and the resource involved.
tool_descriptions.get_message_log: Fetch recent console messages (DSNxxxx) for a subsystem; may return a not-found/connection-error payload when the log is unreachable.
tool_descriptions.get_plan_stats: Return access-path and execution statistics for a plan: rows examined, index usage, and elapsed time.
tool_descriptions.run_reorg: Run a REORG on a table or index (a change action); returns the utility job status and reclaimed space.

min_wait_ms.description: Only return waits above this many ms.

bufferpool {bufferpool} on {db_instance}

| {t0} | {bp0} | {hit_ratio0} | {getpage0} | {sync0} | {async0} |
| {t1} | {bp1} | {hit_ratio1} | {getpage1} | {sync1} | {async1} |
| {t2} | {bp2} | {hit_ratio2} | {getpage2} | {sync2} | {async2} |

lock waits on {db_instance} (min_wait shown):

  waiter=thr-{n2} holder=thr-{n3} resource={table} wait_ms={wait_ms1} mode=U
result_templates.get_log_activity: log activity {db_instance}: write_rate={rate0}/s checkpoint_interval={n0}s log_write_ms={log_ms0} active_log_pct={pct0}
result_templates.get_thread_detail:
thread detail {db_instance} plan={plan}:

result_templates.get_message_log: get_message_log {db_instance}: ERROR DSNL027I subsystem unreachable — no messages returned (connection timed out after {n0}ms). since={t0}
result_templates.get_plan_stats: plan stats {db_instance} plan={plan}: rows_examined={n0} index_used={pct0}% elapsed_ms={elapsed_ms0} sync_io={sync0}
result_templates.run_reorg: run_reorg {db_instance} table={table}: utility=REORG status=COMPLETE rows={n0} reclaimed_pct={pct0}% elapsed_s={n1}

objective_template: {verb} {symptom} on {db_instance}: identify root cause and recommend remediation.
followup_templates: What does the {symptom} trend look like over the last hour on {db_instance}?
Given that, should we reorg {table} or adjust the {bufferpool} bufferpool size?
Are other plans besides {plan} affected on {db_instance}?
followup_connectives: Following up on the previous result,
intro_doc_templates:
Incident ticket INC-{n0} ({db_instance}) — OMEGAMON alert attached:
{t0} DSNJ031I {db_instance} active log write latency high
Summary: {symptom} on {db_instance} since {t0}.
  - bufferpool {bufferpool} hit ratio {hit_ratio0}
  - plan {plan} elapsed climbing; lock waits on {table}
  - log_write_ms={log_ms0}, checkpoint interval widening
Please triage {db_instance} and recommend a remediation.

compaction_summary_template: {verb} {symptom} on {db_instance} (plan {plan}, table {table}). So far: ran {tool_a}, {tool_b}, and {tool_c}; collected bufferpool, lock-wait, and log-activity diagnostics. Findings are still partial; continuing to isolate the bottleneck.
